nodes.odebrane.text.t: The herbalist lifts the lid, sniffs, and gives you half a smile. "Good. Nothing died on the way this time." She scoops you out a handful of salve and hands you a flask.

nodes.s.text.t: An old woman with eyes like wet stones looks out of the hut. "Who sent you? Don't tell me, I know already." She nods you inside.
